purpose: Resolve implementation ambiguities before the first R301 coverage or correlation calculation. This amendment does not inspect signal values or outcomes.

related_prior_evidence.R82: The standalone receivable-growth-low signal had discovery mean IC 0.0496 but validation mean IC -0.0143, validation five-group monotonic rho -0.9, and failed all gates. R301 does not repeat this factor; its incremental-rank gate tests whether revenue growth contributes non-duplicate information beyond receivable growth.
related_prior_evidence.R242: Working-capital-change-low passed data coverage/independence checks but failed the overall predictive/strategy gate set (all_pass=false). R301 does not redefine that formula.
related_prior_evidence.R248: Single-quarter revenue-growth acceleration was previously tested and failed its overall gate set (all_pass=false), despite passing several individual gates. R301 is a level-growth-minus-receivables-growth signal, not a retest or rescue of revenue-growth acceleration; the existing negative result remains binding context.

study_design_clarifications.revenue_component: Use current cumulative YTD revenue divided by cumulative YTD revenue for the same fiscal quarter exactly four fiscal quarters earlier minus one. Do not use reported revenue_yoy; Q2/Q3 comparisons are cumulative same-period growth, as frozen in the parent formula.
study_design_clarifications.receivables_component: Use current-period accounts_receivable divided by accounts_receivable for exactly four fiscal quarters earlier minus one.
study_design_clarifications.sample_clock: The cutoff 2026-10-14 is deliberately fixed from the already frozen parent registration and prior analysis. Later partitions are not read to define or extend this sample.
study_design_clarifications.nonfinite_rule: The denominator conditions in value_rule apply to current cumulative revenue (>0), prior-year cumulative revenue (>0), prior-year receivables (>0), and current receivables (>=0). Require all four source fields finite and resulting value finite.

supersedes.pit_rule: For each symbol and current fiscal period, independently calculate financial_pit_date for current income, current balance sheet, exact four-quarter-lag income, and exact four-quarter-lag balance sheet. Set signal effective_date to max(four PIT dates) + one calendar day. Require exact fiscal period index difference of four for each annual comparison. Backward as-of attach only on dates >= effective_date. Expire when signal_date - current period_end > 180 calendar days.
supersedes.value_rule: Require all four source fields to be present and finite; current cumulative revenue > 0, prior-year cumulative revenue > 0, prior-year accounts_receivable > 0, and current accounts_receivable >= 0. Do not clip or winsorize. Reject any non-finite resulting growth or spread.
supersedes.source_column_rule: Select and rename only the required symbol, period_end, announce_date, revenue, and accounts_receivable columns before joins. Assert unique symbol-period keys in each source and unique output columns after joins.
supersedes.universe_rule: Use exact daily R78 query_date membership. Join the current ext_hy_ths industry map; exclude first-level industries 银行 and 非银金融. Rows with no industry classification are excluded from the eligible denominator and reported separately. State that this classification is not PIT.
supersedes.F2_rule: For each frozen comparator, calculate average absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation over month-end dates with at least 30 paired finite members; report every date, count, and coefficient. F2 fails if a comparator has fewer than 30 eligible month-ends or if the maximum comparator mean exceeds 0.70.
supersedes.F3_rule: On each month-end with at least 30 paired finite candidate and receivable_growth_yoy_low values, rank both cross-sections, regress candidate ranks on an intercept and the existing factor ranks by OLS, and report residual rank standard deviation, its ratio to candidate rank standard deviation, and candidate-old Spearman correlation. F3 passes only if at least 30 paired names and a finite residual rank standard deviation greater than zero are present on at least 80% of all month-ends. This checks non-duplicate rank information only and does not use returns.
supersedes.F4_rule: Before data analysis, run deterministic synthetic checks for exact four-quarter matching, missing/duplicate source keys and duplicate output columns, exclusion through the PIT date with availability beginning the following calendar day, and expiry on age 180 versus age 181.
supersedes.date_rule: Build the full, discovery, validation and recent-252 denominators from distinct R78 query_date values in the frozen sample; recent-252 means the final 252 such dates ending 2026-10-14. For each coverage window report member-row coverage and trading dates with at least one valid name.

panel_registration.sequence: Freeze the parent preregistration hash, this amendment hash and input manifest; GET the candidate panel and save its response; verify no matching R301 exists and prior candidates are unchanged; POST the single factor research candidate exactly once with empty metrics and pending status; GET once for readback and save the proof. Do not retry POST after dispatch.
panel_registration.interpretation: This records a feasibility-stage research item only. It is not a registered factor implementation, backtest, result, validation, deployment or alpha claim.

request_body.name: R301 可行性预注册（未生成因子/无回测结果）

evidence_scope.prohibited: No forward returns, strategy result caches, or trade outcomes; no backtest, provider or builder calls; no writes to market data, formal factor partitions, strategies, R300, production state, LEDGER.md or RESEARCH_SUMMARY.md. The single pending panel registration above is the only external state write. R82, R242 and R248 negative conclusions remain binding context and may not be erased by feasibility results.

decision_rule_unchanged: Any failed F gate rejects this direction before outcome data is read. Passing feasibility never constitutes alpha and requires a separately frozen predictive test registration.
